messages:
Emma (AE): Heads up — TernaNova Systems just asked for an exec-level sync. CISO escalated the POC: main blockers are SSO SAML metadata mismatch + legal asking for a committed pricing band for production. Need a small runbook + owners for an exec call by Thu.
Raj (Solutions Eng): I can take the SSO side. Current error is AssertionConsumerService URL mismatch on their IdP. Quick debug: ask them to paste the SP metadata we gave and verify ACS URL. I can share a one-liner to fetch metadata if they want.
Sophie (Infra Eng): For the KMS part — they want to bring their own key (BYOK). We support it but need key policy + access list from their security team. I can spin a private test env to validate in ~24h if we get policy doc.
Maria (CS): I'll schedule the exec call once we have owners and a short agenda. Suggest: 15 min exec intro (Darren + TernaNova execs), 20 min security deep-dive (Sophie + Raj), 10 min pricing + next steps. Can everyone be available Thu 3pm PT or Fri 10am PT?
Darren (VP Sales): I can be on the call. Need a 1-page options matrix for pricing (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with committed discount tiers and estimated QPS. Maria — can we get that by EOD tomorrow so I can prep the exec brief?
Raj (Solutions Eng): On the metadata fetch — paste this to them:
```
curl -sS https://<sp-host>/metadata | xmllint --format -  
# verify AssertionConsumerService/@Location == https://sp-host/auth/saml/callback
```
If ACS != callback URL, they need to update IdP config or we can provide alternative SP URL for testing.
Emma (AE): +1 on the timeline. I'll draft the 1-pager pricing matrix with three options and ballpark numbers; need inputs on run-rate discounts and SLA uplift costs.
Sophie (Infra Eng): For BYOK validation, send their KMS key policy to legal@redwood.dev and copy me. I can run the validation in our staging KMS. Estimate: 1 day after we have policy + test key.
LegalBot: Reminder: DPA review typically 3-5 business days. If they want faster turnaround, provide the standard addendum form (linked) and confirm contact for e-sign.
Maria (CS): I'll ping their security lead for the key policy and ask IdP admin for metadata right after this thread. Proposed agenda posted in calendar invite once Darren signs off on the times.
Darren (VP Sales): OK — owners: Raj = SSO, Sophie = BYOK/KMS, Emma = pricing doc, Maria = scheduling/legal flow. Emma/Darren will join exec call. If we get the metadata and policy by tomorrow noon, we can hold call Thu 3pm PT. Marking as high priority. :white_check_mark:
Emma (AE): Thanks — I'll upload the 1-pager draft to the shared drive and tag this thread. Will ping again if I need more numbers from finance.
Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 2-slide security summary for the call: SSO findings + remediation steps and a short test plan. ETA tomorrow morning.
Sophie (Infra Eng): I'll reserve a private cluster for the BYOK test and post steps here once ready.
Maria (CS): Noted. I'll send the calendar invite tentatively and mark "pending" until we confirm artifacts. 
Darren (VP Sales): Great work team. Let's aim to have artifacts in place by tomorrow 11:30am PT so we can rehearse a short briefing before the exec call. :rocket:
